svg.title: Observation is not proof of intention
svg.desc: Observation: displayed items gain more interactions in a synthetic model; Mechanism: exposure creates opportunities; logs then influence later rank; Correlation: exposure and interactions move together; Intent requires evidence about the objective and decision-making; Alternative: existing popularity could drive both. Ask what comparison is missing.
svg.text: Observation is not proof of intention
Observation: displayed items gain more interactions in a synthetic model
Mechanism: exposure creates opportunities; logs then influence later rank
Correlation: exposure and interactions move together
Intent requires evidence about the objective and decision-making
Alternative: existing popularity could drive both. Ask what comparison is missing.
